SELECT a, b FROM t WHERE a > 1 ORDER BY b LIMIT 5
SELECT median(a), avg(a), sum(a) FROM t
SELECT s.a FROM t AS s JOIN u ON s.a = u.a
SELECT a FROM t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u)
SELECT a FROM t UNION ALL SELECT a FROM u
WITH c AS (SELECT a FROM t) SELECT * FROM c
WITH c AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM c, t
WITH a1 AS (SELECT 1), a2 AS (SELECT * FROM a1) SELECT * FROM a2
SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE EXISTS (WITH hidden AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM hidden)
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 5) SELECT * FROM r
SELECT (SELECT max(a) FROM u) FROM t
PIVOT t ON a USING sum(b)
SELECT * FROM t SEMI JOIN u USING (a)
SELECT a FROM t QUALIFY row_number() OVER () = 1
